blocks.html: THE SAPPHIRE BLOC BY ROBINSONS LAND CORPORATION AWARDED AS BEST CONDO DEVELOPMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES BY PHILIPPINES PROPERTY AWARDS 2015

Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) claimed this year’s Best Mid-Range Condo Development (Metro Manila) and Best Condo Development (Philippines) for its project in Ortigas Center, The Sapphire Bloc. RLC, together with other winners from different categories will be showcased and will compete at the South East Asia Awards grand finals in Singapore.

The Sapphire Bloc is a four-tower modern Art Deco architecture that stands out on the Ortigas skyline. It is ideally located within the Ortigas Business District where shopping malls, office and condominium skyscrapers, building complexes, and leisure establishments are nearby. True to its City Living Done Right mantra, the project has further enhanced its residents’ living experience by adding a Lifestyle Bloc, where an entire stretch of the development’s ground floor has been dedicated to house one-of-a-kind retail shops and some of the country’s top restaurateurs such as the renowned restobar Cable Car; Australian Cafe Pie Face; premium Coffee Shop Starbucks Reserve; healthy, quick to-go self service store Sprout; after-work drink and dine destination Moonshine Bar; and casual dining place serving Western comfort food Sunshine Kitchen.

The Philippine Property Awards, now on its third year, recognizes the country’s high caliber and outstanding developments which were carefully selected by a panel of esteemed judges. The prestigious awards were received by (L-R) Engr. Manny Arce, RLC VP for Project Management; Ms. Mybelle V. Aragon-GoBio, RLC Senior VP for Robinsons Luxuria, Residences and Communities; Ms. Trina Cipriano, RLC VP for Business Development; and Mr. Mike V. Maneze, The Philippine Star Solutions Team Head.
